name: tabular_group_cv_leaky
title: The same entity-grouped churn table with the group ignored, the target encoder fitted on everything and early stopping watching the test Pool
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-tabular: the defective half of the grouped-CV pair

expected.defect: the smoothed target encoder is fitted on the whole frame five lines before the split
expected.why: every category mean the model trains against was computed with the held-out rows' labels in it, so a rare category's encoded value IS its held-out answer

expected.defect: the frequency encoder is fitted on the whole feature matrix before the split
expected.why: the frequency of each plan is measured over rows the model is later scored on, so no test category is ever unseen

expected.defect: the frequency encoder is re-fitted on the held-out half and used to transform it
expected.why: the model is scored on features encoded by the test set's own statistics rather than by the ones it learned from

expected.defect: cross_val_score is handed a bare CatBoostClassifier over `features`, which prepare() had already target- and frequency-encoded outside any fold
expected.why: no fold refits either encoder, so every fold's score carries the same leak and the cross-validated AUC agrees with the leaked holdout instead of contradicting it

expected.defect: accuracy_score is handed the probability column from predict_proba(...)[:, 1] instead of a decision
expected.why: a continuous vector is compared to 0/1 labels, so the reported accuracy is roughly the chance rate however good the model is - and it is a number, not an error

expected.defect: roc_auc_score is handed booster.predict(...), which is a hard 0/1 label
expected.why: the ROC curve then has two points and the number is balanced accuracy wearing an AUC label
which accounts land in the holdout changes every run, so the reported AUC is not reproducible
the cross-validated baseline moves between runs, so it cannot be compared with the previous experiment

expected.defect: nothing seeds random or numpy, and the booster carries no random_seed
expected.why: two consecutive runs of this script disagree about the number it prints

forbidden.why: TargetEncoder.fit and FrequencyEncoder.fit learn state from the rows they were handed, which is what fit means; the defect is at the call sites in train.py, never in the transformer class
no split exists inside encoders.py, so no value there can carry VAL_SPLIT or TEST_SPLIT
prep.engineer fits nothing - it builds columns with groupby().transform('mean'), which is a pandas aggregation and not a fitted transformer
there is no torch in this project and no hand-written gradient step
model.eval() is a torch idiom; CatBoost has no train/eval mode to forget
torch.no_grad() has no meaning in a CatBoost program
no device is ever named in this project

the table has no timestamp at all - no parse_dates=, no to_datetime, no sort by a date column - so the random split is wrong for a grouping reason, not a temporal one, and MLV106 would be citing evidence that is not there
nothing is pickled or loaded here

notes: Three planted defects have no rule in the catalogue and are therefore unsupported, not missed: (1) two features are group means of the label column (prep.py lines 30-31) - that is MLV105, catalogued but not implemented; (2) the row-wise split at train.py:44 and the KFold at line 64 both put the same account_id on both sides of the cut, and group leakage has no code at all; (3) CatBoost's early stopping watches the test Pool at train.py:57, which is MLV107, catalogued but not implemented.
MLV104 (resampling before the split) is catalogued but not implemented; there is no resampler in this project, so it is named here only to keep the unsupported list complete.
